tha-ap134:1.1: Sudassana.] Vitthatāya nadītīre pilakkhaphalino ahu / tāhaṃ rukkhaṃ gavesanto addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap134:2.1: Ketakaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā vaṇṭe chetvān' ahan tadā / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap134:3.1: Yena ñāṇena patto 'si accutaṃ amataṃ padaṃ / taṃ ñāṇaṃ abhipūjemi Buddhaseṭṭha mahāmuni. // //
tha-ap134:4.1: Ñāṇamhi pūjaṃ katvāna pilakkhaṃ addasaṃ ahaṃ / paṭiladdho 'mhi taṃ saññaṃ ñāṇapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap134:5.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ñāṇapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap134:6.1: Ito terasakappamhi dvādas' āsuṃ Khaluggatā / Sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā. // //
tha-ap134:8.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sudassano thero i. g. a-ti.
